english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for coughing, especially when no expelled substance is specified.
Use this for coughing; the noisy or persistent quality usually comes from the context.

examples.english: I cough a lot these days.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ni1 gei2 jat6 seng4 jat6 kat1

examples.english: They hack nonstop on the bus, and everyone stares at them.
examples.traditional: 佢喺巴士度不停咳，成車人都望住佢。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 bat1 ting4 kat1 sing4 ce1 jan4 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5
